note: Representative surface-temperature extremes, by latitude band. Each value is labeled source-derived, derived-estimate, or placeholder. Local effects such as rocks, slopes, and shadowing are not modeled. Units: kelvin (K).

profiles.name: Equatorial

dayMaxK.processing: Midpoint of the ~387–397 K equatorial daytime maximum reported by Diviner. The spread depends on surface albedo.

nightMinK.processing: Equatorial pre-sunrise minimum (~95 K) reported by Diviner. Rocky areas can be more than 50 K warmer, which is not modeled.

profiles.summary: Hot days near 392 K (119 °C) and nights near 95 K (−178 °C).

profiles.name: Mid-latitude

dayMaxK.processing: Equatorial 392 K scaled by cos(45°)^0.25, a radiative-equilibrium approximation for weaker noon sunlight. This is not a Diviner measurement.

nightMinK.processing: Placeholder until the Diviner global minimum-temperature maps are sampled. It is set slightly below the equatorial minimum.

profiles.summary: Milder days, but nights at least as cold as the equator.
